method: Original project format helpers only. Raw full19158 adult25 macro mesh + raw authored target(s); exact MHCLO refit; evaluate first53 game-engine +59 default facial strategies; compact only after refitting. Six decimal quantization only. All deltas encode authored weight1, not naturalLimit. Natural min/max constrain weights; free mode may extrapolate raw weights at explicit risk.
restrictions: No child/baby/old or age-changing targets; no genital targets/assets; catalog lists names only, not those target files.
Height macros are sex-specific at adult average physique, with absent neutral height target; direct offsets, no scale substitute.
Breast cup/firmness macros only exist for female; authored female offsets with explicit zero male offsets. Not full cup-by-firmness or physique interaction grid.
Symmetric controls sum genuine left+right targets at equal strength; neither duplication nor mirroring.

Eleven controls use documented conservative natural weight limits to eliminate baseline-opposing body triangle normals in both sex endpoints; raw offsets remain unchanged. This screen is not collision certification.
Eye scale affects the eye opening, not eyeball radius; push1 affects outer socket skin, not globe depth. Original helper fit reports correctly retain zero eye changes for these sources.
Eye corner1 is outer and corner2 is inner, verified from original source vertex positions, not guessed from numeric suffix.
Narrow nose/chin/mouth are single authentic decrease targets; never add same-region widening and narrowing at full strength.
Detail/measurement shapes can leave helpers unchanged; zero pivot/attachment effects are retained, not invented.
MHCLO axis scales use abs: additive independently refitted deltas are exact for individual endpoints, not a full combined-target nonlinear re-fit.
No inferred jaw-width target; chin width widening remains original chin_width, narrowing is complementary.
Extreme combined endpoints, body-to-part collisions, lip seals and visual/GPU quality are not certified.
